25687.context: And then a hero comes along. I need to talk to somebody out there. Where's Mariah Carey when you need it? No. Hmm. One keeps the past at the center, the other puts the future in view. And that is what we're trying to do here. Bridge City is not just a place where people come to name what they lost. It's a place where people come to build what they wish existed.
25687.creator: darante-lamar
25687.title: Growing Beyond Past Hurts
